title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Partial Claim Reserve on Restoration by Substitution
content:
When a seller's entitlement on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan is restored by substitution, a partial claim reserve is taken from it where a partial claim is still owed on the loan.

## The reserve

The partial claim reserve is a percentage of the partial claim still owed on the loan, the partial claims paid less the repayments received (the partial claim entries less the partial claim repayment entries in the loan's money transactions, never less than zero):

| Partial claim still owed on the loan | Reserve percentage |
|---|---|
| More than the guaranty in force on the loan record | The above-guaranty percentage, 15 percent |
| Some owed, but no more than the guaranty in force | The within-guaranty percentage, 10 percent |
| None owed | Nothing |

The reserve is the partial claim still owed multiplied by that percentage and divided by one hundred.

## Cases (hypothetical loans, guaranty in force 40,000.00)

| Partial claims paid | Repayments received | Still owed | Percentage | Reserve |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50,000.00 | 5,000.00 | 45,000.00 | 15 | 6,750.00 |
| 40,000.00 | 0.00 | 40,000.00 (equal to the guaranty, not more) | 10 | 4,000.00 |
| 12,000.00 | 2,000.00 | 10,000.00 | 10 | 1,000.00 |
| 12,000.00 | 12,000.00 | 0.00 | — | Nothing |
